name: Giorgi Akhuashvili
medium: Felt-tip marker, ink and watercolour on paper, sometimes on grid paper
colour: acid pink, cyan, lemon yellow and leaf green on white paper, with inky black and deep blue accents, laid in marker strokes and loose washes
form: figures and places built from dense hatching, stipple and repeated marker lines; faces mask-like and ghostly; suburbs, forests and rooms flattened and tilted
never: never smooth digital rendering, never airbrushed gradients, never a dark overall ground
mood: quietly uncanny, tender and a little haunted
consent: VERBAL agreement — the owner, 2026-09-25: the artist agreed to take part. A short written agreement (share, credit, withdrawal) is still to be signed before any label is sold.
charterBy: Claude's draft from the 30 works, 2026-09-23 — the owner replaces it with the artist's own answers
